messages:
Anika: Hey team, quick heads-up — I'm out starting 12:30 UTC for a family holiday and forgot to swap the primary. Sorry for the late notice :grimacing:. Incident-bot already paged for a downstream 5xx spike on inference-hosting in us-west-2. Can someone pick up primary for the next 8 hours?

incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 5xx spike (p50 latency 18ms -> 240ms, error rate 6%) on service.redwood-inference/hosting (us-west-2). Active alerts: 1. Pager severity: P2. Link: https://infra.redwood/alerts/984321

Maya: I'm available, can take primary for the holiday window. Taking ownership now :wave:.

Devon: thanks Maya. Can you confirm whether customer-facing requests are actually failing or just degraded? Any impact to dedicated customers?

Maya: First quick check — grepping logs now. Li, can you paste the quick runbook health-check snippet?

Li: sure — run this against the cluster to check live error rates and leader status:
```
curl -s https://us-west-2.api.redwood/health | jq .services.hosting
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=hosting -o wide
# for tailing recent 5xx logs
kubectl -n inference logs --since=10m -l app=hosting | grep "HTTP/1.1" | grep " 5[0-9][0-9] " | wc -l
```

Maya: ran the health check — main leader pod is showing intermittent 503s, but replicas still up. Current 5xx count ~120 in last 10m, but error ratio concentrated on one task shard. Looks like a degraded downstream model scoring queue (shard-7).

Omar: if shard-7 is the issue, we have a documented mitigation: demote that worker and let autoscaler recreate. Runbook snippet: https://runbooks.redwood/hosting/shard-failure -> section "demote-and-recreate". Quick command: 
```
# mark node unschedulable for shard-7
kubectl -n inference annotate pod hosting-shard-7 redwood/maintenance=true
kubectl -n inference delete pod hosting-shard-7 --grace-period=30
```

TJ: before we do that, any chance this is due to recent deploy? Who rolled last night? If it's a config drift, we should rollback instead of node-level ops.

Anika: no deploys to hosting in the last 24h from release bot. I checked release history: https://ci.redwood/runs?service=hosting — last successful was 36h ago.

Maya: given error shape (steady increase, not a sudden spike), I'm leaning node recreation. I'll run the demote + recreate after we confirm CS notification.

Devon: customer impact: CSR queue shows two active tickets from a paid Dedicated customer in us-west who reported request failures. Notified support to expect potential blips. I pinged @support-team.

Maya: doing the demote now (starting 12:45 UTC). I'll snapshot logs first and then annotate+delete. Posting commands/outputs in case we need rollback.

Maya: (log snapshot) saved to https://logs.redwood/archived/hosting/shard-7/3012346789-snap.txt

Maya: ran annotate and delete. Pod recreated, new pod coming up (status Pending -> Running). Watching metrics.

incident-bot: UPDATE: error rate down to 1.2% (from 6%). p50 latency back to 36ms. No new alerts in the last 3m.

Omar: nice. After it's stable, can we add a short guardrail to autoscaler to avoid repeated restarts for that shard? Opened a ticket: https://tickets.redwood/issue/RI-4821 to track threshold adjustments.

TJ: can confirm support was notified and CS updated the two customers. They asked for ETA — we told them 15-30m and will follow up if there's any regression.

Anika: thanks Maya + Omar. Maya, please take primary for the shift and update the oncall calendar + rotation doc (https://teams.redwood/oncall/rotation). Tag me if you need escalation.

Maya: done — updated calendar and added a short handoff note to the rotation doc. I'll also run through post-mortem checklist after the window ends and collect metrics.

Devon: small follow-ups: 1) add shard-specific health checks to our perf dashboards (so we can alert earlier), 2) include `kubectl describe pod` output in future logs so we can see OOM/eviction quickly.

Maya: agreed on both. I'll add a TODO to the postmortem and assign owners.

Anika: one last ops note — if anything recurs and we need broader escalation, page the oncall rota at /page SRE-P1.

Maya: understood. I'm monitoring, will post updates here if anything changes. :shipit:
